lines.text: Many learners say: I very like pizza.
Better: I like pizza very much.
Put very much after the thing.
Much! I like cats very much.

data.why: Put very much after the thing.

native.tip: very は動詞の前に置けません。like ～ very much の順にします。
native.caption: “I very like pizza.”と言っていませんか？😅 「とても好き」を I very like と言いたくなりますが、英語では very much を文の後ろに置きます。 “I like pizza very much.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“much”。very much は後ろに置きます。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.tip: Very cannot go before a verb. Say like it very much.
en.caption: Do you say “I very like pizza.”? 😅 I very like is tempting, but English puts very much after the object. The natural way is “I like pizza very much.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
